summary: Build a growth-focused public landing page for the GrowInLove app (mobile-first with desktop variation), including a light/dark toggle, blush aesthetic, CTA button linking to the app, updated founder story content, and a footer with standard links plus an investor-interest link.
architectural_notes: Landing page should be static (no backend/API), ideally React + Tailwind, with assets stored locally and a single route (e.g., /).
known_issues: Caffeine platform credit balance may display as available while builder blocks builds (credit-sync mismatch); may require support ticket.

- Tree-and-hearts inspired hero illustration, soft blush palette (landing-hero-illustration.dim_1400x900.png)

existing_features.title: Create a new single-page public marketing landing page for GrowInLove that is shown to unauthenticated visitors instead of the current centered login-only welcome screen.

Implement the landing page sections from the approved wireframe and project scope: header (logo + light/dark toggle), hero (tree-inspired branding), benefit trio, product screenshot carousel, founder story section (using the provided founder story content already in the project context), privacy reassurance section, optional feature deep-dives section, final CTA section, and footer. Do not include testimonials/social proof.

Add a primary landing-page CTA that links directly to the deployed app experience (the authenticated app shell), and provide a secondary CTA that brings users to sign in (Internet Identity) if they choose. Ensure the CTA behavior is clear and works without introducing a router.
Apply a consistent blush/cream romantic aesthetic to the landing page and ensure it fully supports the existing light/dark theme system (including a visible theme toggle on the landing page).

Implement the landing page footer with labeled links: About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, plus an investor-interest link labeled exactly “Interested in supporting our growth?”. Ensure each footer link has a clear text label (including the existing ones) and behaves consistently.

Add a product screenshot carousel to the landing page using static images bundled with the frontend (no backend calls). Include basic controls (swipe on mobile and clickable next/prev on desktop) and ensure images are responsive and performant.

Use the user-uploaded tree-and-hearts image as branding inspiration by generating new logo/wordmark and a hero illustration variant as static assets, and update the landing page header/hero to use them. Keep existing in-app logo usage unchanged unless explicitly replaced on the landing page only.
